svg.aria-label: Three exam adjectives: least operational overhead means fewest self-managed components, least custom development effort means managed features, most cost-effective means token math
svg.text: The three adjectives that pick the winner
The stem names the winner before you read the options.
Fewest self-managed components. Example: Aurora Serverless over a self-managed OpenSearch cluster.
Managed features over your own code. Example: Knowledge Bases over a hand-built ingestion pipeline.
Token math. Example: The smallest model that clears the quality bar; caching; batch; cascade.
The scenario does not change; the winner does. Read the adjective first.
